# axe-core 4.11.1

Deque's accessibility rules engine, used only by `scripts/design_check.py`, which injects it into pages on a local preview. No page of Exegetica loads or serves it.

- `axe.min.js` SHA-256: `7dbfabdfc6062936d79c873ddbb5f811a1219fca3928bd8cc9dd81f1e65f4720`

To update it, replace the three files from a newer npm release and change the version and hash here.
